maps.name: 废弃矿坑
maps.scene: ABANDONED MINE. Broad simple dark blue-gray mine tunnel arch framed at extreme edges with two thick chunky aged brown timber supports and one horizontal beam above. Two distant broad shadow tunnel shapes. Small muted turquoise crystal cluster confined to far right edge, simple broken mining cart silhouette far left against wall. Warm ochre lamp at upper right, subtle flat amber light patch, no glow gradients. A short rail segment in far background, never across the actor floor. Main floor a large plain warm gray-tan stone strip. Desaturated slate, muted wood brown and ochre, a touch of cyan. Friendly adventurous mood, uncluttered like a coarse cartoon pixel cavern.

maps.name: 迷雾林地
maps.scene: MIST FOREST. Extreme left and right framed with just two big thick moss-green tree trunks and broad stair-stepped canopy masses above. Two simple layers of muted teal tree silhouettes in distant upper half, large flat pale sage mist bands in center, no individual leaves, no fine branches. Tiny mushroom group only at far left edge and a few chunky grass tufts at far right. Broad flat pale desaturated olive earth floor, quiet empty central glade. Muted eucalyptus green, blue-gray mist, warm ivory earth, gentle mysterious friendly atmosphere. Low contrast simple silhouettes.

maps.name: 沉没遗迹

Ancient flooded temple seen side-on with two thick pale sandstone broken columns at extreme edges, large simple stair-stepped broken arch silhouettes high in back, one broad rectangular teal recess in center background. Still blue-green water confined to a BACKGROUND channel above the combat floor, three large flat reflection strips, no intricate ripples. One small sea-green moss patch on left column. Broad dry plain pale blue-gray stone platform spanning full width at 79% height, safe open feet lane, no water covering feet. Muted turquoise, slate blue, pale limestone, tiny dull gold accents. Friendly mysterious ancient atmosphere, big clear color masses.

maps.name: 灰烬堡垒
maps.scene: EMBER FORTRESS. Two very large dark charcoal castle wall silhouettes at extreme sides, thick blocky crenellations high in background, a broad simple gate arch behind center in subdued rust-gray. Distant muted red volcanic horizon visible only high behind walls, two small amber furnace openings near extreme edges, one narrow orange lava channel confined to BACKGROUND behind stone battle floor. No tiny sparks or smoke particles. Broad plain warm slate stone floor spanning full width at 79% height, no lava at actor feet. Desaturated charcoal, warm brick, burnt sienna and restrained dull amber. Dramatic but friendly cartoon fantasy, large simple color clusters, central low contrast.
